reason: A harness goal turn's cleanup posts pending subagent reports before settling the goal; a posted report can start the goal's next turn, advancing its step and moving its execution claim. The older turn's _settle_goal_turn then paused the goal for the newer turn's step budget mid-turn and cleared that turn's claim, so a completion it proposed was refused. _settle_goal_turn now leaves a goal claimed by another turn to that turn and _pause_goal re-checks ownership per attempt. The flaky test_late_subagent_report_resumes_parked_harness_goal_once (failing ~half of runs on main) waited on _chat_turn_tasks emptying, which precedes settle; it now awaits the turn task. A new deterministic test covers a report arriving before the earlier turn settles. Selected: harness and provider goal suites and single-active harness chat.
exclusions: test_harness_chat_goals.py::test_operator_interruption_pauses_harness_goal and ::test_goal_resume_uses_saved_next_harness_in_same_chat (2 params) fail identically on pristine origin/main and with this patch; test_goal_handoff.py and test_subagent_delivery.py also exercise goals and reports but 9 of their cases fail identically on main and with this patch, so they are not selected. No UI, native or Playwright cases: no frontend code changed. No real-Core harness check: the scratch Core has no inert harness executable (the host's Codex/Grok CLIs would contact external services).
